{"id": "72dc7ebe-7c97-4777-a7de-cc6ded576fde", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Why are my Lambda functions in eu-central-1 slow on the first request after a quiet period?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}

{"id": "cfc3b071-f282-4671-bb0a-e42158f6e625", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "That's the classic Lambda **cold start** pattern. Here's what's happening:

- **Execution environments are ephemeral.** Lambda keeps a warm execution environment (with your code, runtime, and any SDK/connection state) around only while it's getting steady traffic. After a quiet period, Lambda reclaims idle environments.
- **The next request has to build one from scratch** — download your package, start the runtime, run any top-level/init code (SDK clients, DB connections, config loads), then your handler. That init work is the extra latency you're seeing, on top of the normal invoke time.
- **Factors that make it worse:**
  - Larger deployment packages or container images take longer to initialize.
  - VPC-attached functions used to add ENI-creation latency on cold start (largely mitigated since Hyperplane ENIs, but still a factor on burst scaling).
  - Heavy init-phase code (big SDK imports, synchronous network calls at module load, large dependency trees) adds to cold start time.
  - Runtime matters too — JVM-based runtimes (Java) and .NET tend to have noticeably longer cold starts than Node.js or Python.
- **Regional/account-level factor:** this isn't eu-central-1-specific behavior — it's the same mechanism everywhere — but if you're seeing it disproportionately there, it's usually just because that region has lower/burstier traffic for those functions, so environments go idle and get reclaimed more often.

Common mitigations: Provisioned Concurrency (keeps environments warm), reducing package size, moving heavy init work out of the critical path or lazy-loading it, and for latency-sensitive paths, a periodic warming ping (though Provisioned Concurrency is the more reliable fix).

If you want, I can pull actual invocation/duration metrics for your specific functions in eu-central-1 to confirm this is cold-start-driven and see how often it's happening.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
